name: xDAI
oneLiner: xDAI is the native gas token of Gnosis Chain, backed 1:1 by USDS bridged through Gnosis bridge infrastructure and inheriting Sky's collateral mix.
collateral: USDS locked or bridged through Gnosis Chain bridge infrastructure, with wrapped WXDAI used for ERC-20 integrations
pegMechanism: Native gas token on Gnosis Chain backed by bridged USDS; users can bridge between USDS and xDAI through official Gnosis bridge routes

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: xDAI is a native gas token backed by assets bridged through Gnosis bridge infrastructure; Pharos records possible administrative or bridge-route control uncertainty, but the reviewed sources do not prove a holder-level blacklist path on native xDAI balances.

mintAuthority.summary: xDAI is Gnosis Chain native gas-token accounting backed by bridged Sky USDS/DAI routes; base mint authority is inherited from reviewed USDS while bridge/native accounting remains a separate route risk with a 4/7 bridge validator threshold and 8/15 governance owner threshold.

controls.label: Gnosis xDAI native bridge/accounting route
controls.capDescription: xDAI native accounting is bounded by the Gnosis bridge route and upstream USDS/DAI backing, with bridge owner controls able to change route parameters.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Official Gnosis bridge routes lock or account for upstream USDS/DAI backing native xDAI.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Official bridge route with current validator threshold resolved as 4-of-7.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Ethereum block 25295194, ForeignBridge (0x4aa42145) proxyOwner() returned 0x42F38ec5A75acCEc50054671233dfAC9C0E7A3F6; Safe API confirmed this is an 8/15 Safe (v1.3.0, modules=[], guard=0x0).

Safe API confirmed 8/15 threshold, 15 owners, modules=[], guard=0x0, version 1.3.0. Bridge admin threshold corrected from 4/7 (validator threshold) to 8/15 (governance Safe). xDAI inherits upstream USDS mint authority; bridge route risk is captured by the bridge-admin control.

reserves.name: USDS backing through Gnosis bridge infrastructure

notices.title: Native gas-token supply
notices.message: xDAI is native to Gnosis Chain; the configured contract is listed as a traded wrapper rather than a canonical supply contract.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: xDAI is native bridged supply backed by USDS held through the canonical xDAI bridge rather than collateralized borrowing.
